no_adcom_quote.quote: The application was not referred to a meeting of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial clinical issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for KADCYLA (BLA125427). The Summary Review's Advisory Committee Meeting section states the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial clinical issues warranting discussion. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
